name: ax
one_liner: Infrastructure software that lets a company run huge numbers of AI 'agent' tasks reliably on its own servers, packing many idle agents onto few machines the way a hotel overbooks rooms nobody sleeps in all day.
buyer: A platform engineering lead at a company building an AI agent product (a coding assistant, an automation platform) who needs to run thousands of agent sessions without paying for a dedicated server per agent.
business_use_cases: An AI coding-assistant startup uses AX to host thousands of customer coding sessions on a small fleet of Kubernetes nodes, cutting hosting costs.
An 'AI employee' automation vendor uses AX's suspend/resume to pause idle customer agents instantly instead of paying for always-on compute.
An MCP tooling vendor uses AX's sandbox and network gateway to isolate one customer's tool calls and API keys from another's.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed hosting of AX clusters for AI startups that don't want to run their own Kubernetes control plane.
Consulting: migrate a company's per-agent-VM setup onto AX and bill against the measured infra savings.

steal_this: This is Kubernetes-operator-grade infrastructure the README itself calls pre-stable with breaking changes likely — nothing buildable this weekend beyond a proof-of-concept demo cluster.
